detail.longDescription: ⚠️ "The National Institutes of Health (NIH) awarded nearly 12% fewer grants, or 7,400, in fiscal year 2026 compared to the year before President Donald Trump took office for his second term, according to a new analysis from the Association of American Medical Colleges." https://www. cidrap.umn.edu/public-health/n ih-sees-7400-fewer-grants-during-fiscal-year-2026-previous-year # research # PublicHealth
